objective_breakdown: HEV cell: stage2 ED>=327.18 Wh/kg (calc-energy contract caliber; baseline mass est. ~43.5 g, ~18 Wh@1C -> ~420 Wh/kg, expected pass with margin); SEI<=550 nm after 100x1C@45C (baseline ~449 nm@25C per skill signal; 45C effect to be measured); stage3: 4C charge no plating (plated=false; binding constraint expected, thick high-loading NMC811/graphite at 4C typically dips graphite potential <0 V); nail 10 W no thermal runaway (triggered=false; contract cooling hA~0.05 W/K nearly adiabatic -> thermal-management design freedom is the lever); stage1 elimination lines pre-registered for possible Stage-2 escalation. Trade-offs: ED margin (if confirmed) is spent on plating robustness; nail solved via cooling h (thermal management freedom), not mass.
candidate_strategy: Base Chen2020 (anchor-table default, dump-verified NMC811/graphite). R1: full baseline characterization + opening ED ceiling assessment (thin collectors/separator, low porosity, high-transport electrolyte) to pre-emptively decide Stage-2 escalation. R2+: 2-4 variants/round through full protocol set. Plating levers: negative particle radius 5.86->2-3 um, N/P up, electrolyte sigma 1.1->2-3 S/m, t+ 0.2594->0.5, cooling h up. SEI levers: coating bridge SEI kinetic rate constant x0.1 (FEC/VC-class) / SEI j0 x0.1 (Al2O3-class), literature estimate, same-system comparison. Nail levers: hA = h x A_cooling, liquid cooling h=50-500. ED levers (if margin erodes): separator 12->8-9 um, collectors 16/12->10/6 um.
budget_allocation: ~10 rounds: R1 baseline+ceiling; R2-R4 plating-focused architecture/formulation; R5 SEI coating; R6-R7 nail/thermal consolidation; R8 full-criteria DFN re-verification; R9 closing. Rebalance toward failing metric at R4 via plan update.
risk_and_fallback: Plating 3-strike -> question (a) system reachability at 4C/45C, (b) electrolyte transport freedom scope, (c) task reachability; escalate to system switch (OKane2022 SiOx) before negative conclusion. SEI>550 -> coating bridge -> if still failing, Stage-2 molecular funnel (FEC/VC-class additives). Nail triggered -> raise hA via cooling design until triggered=false with T_eq<=345K; keep h consistent with 4C thermal model. ED<327.18 -> architecture ED levers -> Stage-2 escalation (SiOx/LNMO). Solver failures recorded verbatim; DFN auto-degrades to SPMe; no fabricated values.
